stem.text: The total weight of a motorbike and rider is $1800\,\text{N}$. The motorbike travels in a straight line at constant speed up a hill at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.

stem.text: The useful output power of the motorbike is $36\,000\,\text{W}$. The total resistive force due to air resistance and friction on the motorbike and rider is $2400\,\text{N}$.
